@_register("geometric_triangle_breakout", "الأنماط الهندسية",
           ["confirmed pivots", "least-squares trendlines", "converging triangle", "fresh close breakout"],
           "structure", 60)
def geometric_triangle_breakout(b, c):
    swings = _alternating_pivots(c["pivots"])
    highs = [p for p in swings if p["kind"] == "HIGH"][-3:]
    lows = [p for p in swings if p["kind"] == "LOW"][-3:]
    if len(highs) < 3 or len(lows) < 3:
        return _result(missing=["three confirmed highs and three confirmed lows"])
    high_slope, high_intercept, high_residual = _linear_fit(highs)
    low_slope, low_intercept, low_residual = _linear_fit(lows)
    start_index = min(highs[0]["index"], lows[0]["index"])
    previous_index, current_index = len(b)-2, len(b)-1
    upper_start = high_intercept + high_slope * start_index
    lower_start = low_intercept + low_slope * start_index
    upper_previous = high_intercept + high_slope * previous_index
    lower_previous = low_intercept + low_slope * previous_index
    upper_now = high_intercept + high_slope * current_index
    lower_now = low_intercept + low_slope * current_index
    initial_height, current_height = upper_start-lower_start, upper_now-lower_now
    minimum_slope, flat_slope = .03*c["atr"], .04*c["atr"]
    symmetric = high_slope < -minimum_slope and low_slope > minimum_slope
    ascending = abs(high_slope) <= flat_slope and low_slope > minimum_slope
    descending = high_slope < -minimum_slope and abs(low_slope) <= flat_slope
    pattern_type = ("symmetrical_triangle" if symmetric else "ascending_triangle" if ascending else
                    "descending_triangle" if descending else None)
    span = max(highs[-1]["index"], lows[-1]["index"]) - start_index
    recent = current_index-max(highs[-1]["index"], lows[-1]["index"]) <= 15
    residual_ok = max(high_residual, low_residual) <= .35*c["atr"]
    converging = (pattern_type is not None and 8 <= span <= 60 and recent and residual_ok and
                  initial_height > 0 and .3*c["atr"] <= current_height <= .8*initial_height)
    prior_closes_inside = converging and all(
        low_intercept+low_slope*i-.15*c["atr"] <= b[i]["close"] <=
        high_intercept+high_slope*i+.15*c["atr"]
        for i in range(start_index, current_index)
    )
    bull = prior_closes_inside and b[-2]["close"] <= upper_previous and b[-1]["close"] > upper_now
    bear = prior_closes_inside and b[-2]["close"] >= lower_previous and b[-1]["close"] < lower_now
    side = "BUY" if bull else "SELL" if bear else "NEUTRAL"
    triggered = bull or bear
    geometry = {
        "pattern": pattern_type,
        "upper_slope_per_bar": high_slope,
        "lower_slope_per_bar": low_slope,
        "upper_residual": high_residual,
        "lower_residual": low_residual,
        "initial_height": initial_height,
        "current_height": current_height,
        "upper_now": upper_now,
        "lower_now": lower_now,
        "latest_pivot_confirmed_at": max(p["confirmed_at"] for p in highs+lows),
        "prior_closes_inside": prior_closes_inside,
    }
    target = b[-1]["close"]+initial_height if bull else b[-1]["close"]-initial_height if bear else None
    return _result(
        side, triggered, upper_now if bull else lower_now if bear else None,
        lower_now if bull else upper_now if bear else None,
        [_evidence("geometric_pattern", geometry, b, "converging triangle geometry"), *highs, *lows],
        (["converging triangle geometry"] if converging and prior_closes_inside else []) +
        (["fresh completed close outside triangle"] if triggered else []),
        ([] if triggered else ["triangle breakout on the latest completed bar"])
        if converging and prior_closes_inside else ["confirmed converging triangle"],
        ["Regression lines describe confirmed OHLC pivots; they do not imply exact discretionary trendlines"],
        targets=[{"price": target, "method": "triangle height projected from breakout close", "fraction": 1.0}]
        if triggered else None,
    )

@_register("darvas_box", "Darvas Box", ["confirmed 20 bar box"], "structure", 35)
def darvas_box(b, c):
    window = b[-21:-1]
    top = max(x["high"] for x in window)
    bottom = min(x["low"] for x in window)

@_register("ichimoku_cross", "إيشيموكو", ["Tenkan 9", "Kijun 26", "Senkou 52 lagged 26"], "trend", 80)
def ichimoku_cross(b, c):
    tenkan, kijun = _mid(b, 9), _mid(b, 26)

                               "cloud_origin_time": historical[-1]["time"]}, b, "cloud calculated 26 completed bars earlier")],

@_register("volatility_breakout", "مؤشرات التقلب", ["Bollinger 20/2", "bandwidth contraction"], "volatility", 65)
def volatility_breakout(b, c):
    closes = [x["close"] for x in b]

@_register("zscore_reversion", "العودة إلى المتوسط والتحليل الإحصائي", ["rolling zscore 40", "mean slope filter"], "statistical", 65)
def zscore_reversion(b, c):
    closes = [x["close"] for x in b]
    training = closes[-42:-2]
    mean, sd = statistics.fmean(training), statistics.pstdev(training)
    if sd <= 0:

    target = mean if (bull and mean > closes[-1]) or (bear and mean < closes[-1]) else None

                   min(x["low"] for x in b[-5:]) if bull else max(x["high"] for x in b[-5:]),
                   [_evidence("zscore", {"mean": mean, "sd": sd, "before": before, "current": now, "stable": stable}, b, "mean estimated before both trigger bars")],

@_register("harmonic_abcd", "الهارمونيك: نموذج الأضلاع المتساوية", ["confirmed alternating pivots", "AB/CD ratio"], "structure", 60)
def harmonic_abcd(b, c):
    p = _alternating_pivots(c["pivots"])[-4:]
    assumptions = ["Equal-leg model only; not all harmonic patterns; entry confirmation and tolerances are house rules"]
    if len(p) < 4:
        return _result(missing=["four confirmed alternating harmonic pivots"], assumptions=assumptions)
    a, base, turn, end = p
    bull = [x["kind"] for x in p] == ["HIGH", "LOW", "HIGH", "LOW"]
    sign = 1 if bull else -1
    ab = sign*(a["price"]-base["price"])
    bc = sign*(turn["price"]-base["price"])
    cd = sign*(turn["price"]-end["price"])
    ratios = {"retracement": bc/ab if ab > 0 else None, "equality": cd/ab if ab > 0 else None,
              "projection": cd/bc if bc > 0 else None}
    geometry = (ab > 0 and bc > 0 and cd > 0 and .382 <= bc/ab <= .886
                and .95 <= cd/ab <= 1.05 and 1.13 <= cd/bc <= 2.618)

def spring_test(b,c):
    for index in range(len(b)-3,len(b)-9,-1):
        prior=b[index-40:index];spring=b[index];post=b[index+1:-1];x=b[-1]
        if len(prior)!=40 or not post:continue

        if scale<=0 or hi-lo<3*scale or abs(prior[-1]["close"]-prior[0]["close"])>.25*(hi-lo):continue
        if min(x.get("tick_volume",0),spring.get("tick_volume",0))<=0:continue
        light=x["tick_volume"]<=spring["tick_volume"]
        bull=(spring["low"]<lo<spring["close"]<hi and max(z["close"] for z in post)>lo+scale
              and all(z["low"]>lo+.25*scale for z in post) and lo<=x["low"]<=lo+.25*scale
              and x["close"]>b[-2]["close"] and x["close"]<(lo+hi)/2 and light)
        bear=(spring["high"]>hi>spring["close"]>lo and min(z["close"] for z in post)<hi-scale

@specialist("pin_rejection", "رفض الذيل عند حد سعري", "Boundary pin rejection", "candle",
            ["Touch or sweep prior 20-bar extreme and close back inside", "Dominant wick >= 2 bodies and >= 60% of range; opposite wick <= 20%; range >= 0.5 prior ATR"],
            {"lookback": 20, "wick_body": 2, "wick_range": .6, "opposite_wick": .2})
def pin_rejection(b, c):
    x, p = b[-1], b[-21:-1]
    span, body = x["high"]-x["low"], abs(x["close"]-x["open"])
    lower, upper = min(x["open"], x["close"])-x["low"], x["high"]-max(x["open"], x["close"])
    hi, lo = max(z["high"] for z in p), min(z["low"] for z in p)
    valid = span >= .5*atr(b[:-1]) and span > 0
    bull = valid and lower >= max(2*body, .6*span) and upper <= .2*span and x["low"] <= lo < x["close"]
    bear = valid and upper >= max(2*body, .6*span) and lower <= .2*span and x["high"] >= hi > x["close"]
    return signal(b, bull, bear, x["low"], x["high"], {"low": lo, "high": hi, "lower_wick": lower, "upper_wick": upper})

rules.algorithm_python:
@specialist("regression_reentry", "عودة إلى قناة الانحدار", "Regression residual reentry", "statistical",
            ["OLS on 30 closes preceding both trigger bars; population residual deviation", "Previous residual outside 2 deviations; latest residual recross inside toward projected center"],
            {"lookback": 30, "deviations": 2}, ("RANGE", "MIXED"))
def regression_reentry(b, c):
    values = [x["close"] for x in b[-32:-2]]
    n, mean = len(values), statistics.fmean(values)
    center = (n-1)/2
    slope = sum((i-center)*(y-mean) for i, y in enumerate(values))/sum((i-center)**2 for i in range(n))
    fitted = [mean+slope*(i-center) for i in range(n)]
    sd = (sum((a-z)**2 for a, z in zip(values, fitted))/n)**.5
    prev_center, now_center = mean+slope*(n-center), mean+slope*(n+1-center)
    prev, now = b[-2]["close"]-prev_center, b[-1]["close"]-now_center
    return signal(b, sd > 1e-12 and prev < -2*sd <= now < 0, sd > 1e-12 and prev > 2*sd >= now > 0,
                  min(x["low"] for x in b[-2:]), max(x["high"] for x in b[-2:]), {"mean": now_center, "slope": slope, "deviation": sd}, now_center)

def tick_activity_rejection(b, c):
    x=b[-1]
    volumes=[z.get("tick_volume",0) for z in b[-21:]]

        return _result(status="DATA_MISSING",missing=["positive bar tick counts required for local activity proxy"])
    baseline=statistics.median(volumes[:-1])

@specialist("obv_divergence_reclaim", "اختلاف OBV التقريبي واستعادة المستوى", "Tick-count OBV divergence and price reclaim proxy", "volume",
            ["Fixed 60 completed bars preceding the trigger plus the trigger; positive finite MT5 tick_volume on every bar; never substitute real_volume or silently fill missing activity",
             "Start OBV at zero at the window's first bar; add / subtract the current bar tick count when close rises / falls versus the preceding close; unchanged closes add zero",
             "Newest two strict confirmed five-bar lows: lower price low with strictly higher OBV; bearish mirror is higher price high with strictly lower OBV; dual high/low pivots and ties excluded",
             "Pivot separation <= 30 bars; trigger occurs 1..8 bars after the second right confirmation bar, which must precede the trigger",
             "Fresh completed close reclaims the maximum intervening high for BUY / minimum intervening low for SELL; latest divergence pivot remains unbroken through trigger and supplies the structural stop; opposing simultaneous triggers abstain",
             "House divergence, confirmation, expiry and reclaim definition; tick-count candle-volume proxy, not actual order flow or the complete OBV theory"],
            {"lookback": 60, "left_bars": 2, "right_closed_bars": 2,
             "max_pivot_separation": 30, "max_confirmation_age": 8, "volume_source": "tick_volume"})
def obv_divergence_reclaim(b, c):
    if len(b) < 61:
        return _result(status="DATA_MISSING", missing=["61 completed bars required for bounded OBV proxy"],
                       assumptions=[OBV_TICK_ASSUMPTION])
    offset = len(b)-61
    window = b[offset:]
    volumes = [x.get("tick_volume") for x in window]
    if any(isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(v) or v <= 0 for v in volumes):
        return _result(status="DATA_MISSING", missing=["positive finite tick counts required for every bounded OBV bar"],
                       assumptions=[OBV_TICK_ASSUMPTION])
    obv = [0.0]
    for previous, current, volume in zip(window, window[1:], volumes[1:]):
        change = volume if current["close"] > previous["close"] else -volume if current["close"] < previous["close"] else 0
        obv.append(obv[-1]+change)
    if any(not math.isfinite(value) for value in obv):
        return _result(status="DATA_INVALID", missing=["bounded OBV cumulative value must be finite"],
                       assumptions=[OBV_TICK_ASSUMPTION])
    pivots = _prior_five_bar_pivots(b)
    details = {"lookback": 60, "volume_source": "tick_volume", "volume_units": "tick_count",
                   "obv_origin_time": window[0]["time"], "obv_current": obv[-1],
                   "reference_precedes_trigger": True, "bullish_setup": None, "bearish_setup": None}
    setups = {}
    for kind in ("LOW", "HIGH"):
        selected = [p for p in pivots if p["kind"] == kind]
        if len(selected) < 2:
            continue
        first, second = selected[-2:]
        distance = second["index"]-first["index"]
        age = len(b)-1-(second["index"]+2)
        first_obv, second_obv = obv[first["index"]-offset], obv[second["index"]-offset]
        bullish = kind == "LOW"
        divergence = (second["price"] < first["price"] and second_obv > first_obv if bullish else
                      second["price"] > first["price"] and second_obv < first_obv)
        between = b[first["index"]+1:second["index"]]
        level = max(x["high"] for x in between) if bullish else min(x["low"] for x in between)
        intact = all(x["low"] >= second["price"] if bullish else x["high"] <= second["price"]
                     for x in b[second["index"]+1:])
        crossed = b[-2]["close"] <= level < b[-1]["close"] if bullish else b[-2]["close"] >= level > b[-1]["close"]
        setup = {"first_pivot": first, "second_pivot": second, "first_obv": first_obv, "second_obv": second_obv,
                     "divergence": divergence, "pivot_separation": distance, "confirmation_age": age,
                     "reclaim_level": level, "pivot_intact": intact}
        details["bullish_setup" if bullish else "bearish_setup"] = setup
        setups[kind] = (divergence and distance <= 30 and 1 <= age <= 8 and intact and crossed, second["price"])
    bull, stop_buy = setups.get("LOW", (False, None))
    bear, stop_sell = setups.get("HIGH", (False, None))
    result = signal(b, bull, bear, stop_buy, stop_sell, details)
    result["assumptions"].append(OBV_TICK_ASSUMPTION)
    return result

       {'indicators': ['range40', 'efficiency40', 'tick_activity'], 'activity_multiple': 1.5},
       needs=['completed_ohlc', 'positive_tick_volume'], source='https://www.wyckoffanalytics.com/wyckoff-method/')
def wyckoff_range_expansion(b, c):
    prior = b[-41:-1]; x = b[-1]; volumes = [z.get('tick_volume') for z in b[-21:]]
    if any(isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(v) or v <= 0 for v in volumes):
        return st._result(status='DATA_MISSING', missing=['positive finite tick counts required for range expansion'])
    a = st.atr(prior); hi = max(z['high'] for z in prior); lo = min(z['low'] for z in prior)
    travel = sum(abs(q['close']-p['close']) for p, q in itertools.pairwise(prior))
    efficiency = abs(prior[-1]['close']-prior[0]['close'])/travel if travel else 0
    span = x['high']-x['low']; location = (x['close']-x['low'])/span if span else .5
    active = a > 0 and hi-lo >= 3*a and efficiency <= .25 and abs(x['close']-x['open']) >= a and volumes[-1] >= 1.5*statistics.median(volumes[:-1])
    bull = active and b[-2]['close'] <= hi < x['close'] and x['close'] > x['open'] and location >= .8
    bear = active and b[-2]['close'] >= lo > x['close'] and x['close'] < x['open'] and location <= .2
    result = signal(b, bull, bear, min(z['low'] for z in b[-6:]), max(z['high'] for z in b[-6:]),
                    {'range_low': lo, 'range_high': hi, 'efficiency': efficiency, 'location': location, 'activity_ratio': volumes[-1]/statistics.median(volumes[:-1])})
    result['assumptions'].append('range expansion uses tick activity, not actual institutional volume')

@model('darvas_rising_boxes', 'دارفاس: تتابع صندوقين مؤكدين', 'Darvas two-box continuation', 'structure',
       ['صندوقان متتابعان من عشرين شمعة لكل منهما؛ سقف كل صندوق يسبق ثلاث قمم أدنى بصورة صارمة.',
        'ارتفاع السقف والقاع معاً ثم اختراق جديد للسقف للشراء، أو انخفاضهما واختراق القاع للبيع؛ الوقف عند الحد المقابل.'],
       ['Two consecutive 20-bar boxes; each top precedes at least three strictly lower highs.',
        'Both boundaries rise then fresh upper break for buy, or both fall then lower break for sell; opposite edge stop.'],
       {'indicators': ['two_confirmed_20_bar_boxes'], 'box_bars': 20, 'top_confirmation_bars': 3})
def darvas_rising_boxes(b, c):
    boxes = []
    for window in (b[-41:-21], b[-21:-1]):
        hi = max(z['high'] for z in window); lo = min(z['low'] for z in window)
        index = next(i for i, z in enumerate(window) if z['high'] == hi)
        valid = hi > lo and index <= 16 and all(z['high'] < hi for z in window[index+1:])
        boxes.append({'high': hi, 'low': lo, 'confirmed': valid})
    old, new = boxes; valid = old['confirmed'] and new['confirmed']
    bull = valid and new['high'] > old['high'] and new['low'] > old['low'] and b[-2]['close'] <= new['high'] < b[-1]['close'] and b[-1]['low'] > new['low']
    bear = valid and new['high'] < old['high'] and new['low'] < old['low'] and b[-2]['close'] >= new['low'] > b[-1]['close'] and b[-1]['high'] < new['high']
    return signal(b, bull, bear, new['low'], new['high'], {'boxes': boxes})
